servicesHeader.title: Our Core Services
servicesHeader.description: An end-to-end ecosystem covering design, 3D visualization, drafting, contracting, and construction execution.

services.title: Interior & Exterior Contractor
services.subtitle: Turnkey fit-out, custom joinery, bespoke finishes & climate-engineered exterior facades.
services.description: We bridge the gap between creative vision and physical reality. As licensed general contractors, we manage luxury millwork, acoustic wall systems, and high-end facade installation.
services.deliverables: Complete built space, material certificates, 2-year warranty.

services.title: 3D Design & Architect
services.subtitle: Photorealistic 8K renderings, spatial layout design & immersive VR architectural walkthroughs.
services.description: Experience your vision before groundbreaking. Our senior architects craft hyper-realistic digital twins of your space, modeling real-world physics and lighting.
services.deliverables: High-res render packages, VR 360 viewer links, PDF masterplan.

services.title: Architectural & BIM Drafter
services.subtitle: CAD drafting, structural blueprints, MEP schematics & permit-ready construction drawings.
services.description: Technical accuracy is the foundation of flawless construction. Our team creates complete CAD drawing sets, 3D BIM models, and structural calculations.
services.deliverables: AutoCAD .DWG files, Revit BIM models, stamped permit drawings.

services.title: General Construction & Build
services.subtitle: Structural engineering, foundation work, project management & ground-up construction.
services.description: From breaking ground to final key handover, our construction division handles heavy structural works, reinforced concrete framing, and steel structures.
services.deliverables: Occupancy permits, structural warranties, as-built documentation.

workflow.title: 5-Step Execution Workflow
workflow.description: Proses pengerjaan transparan dari konsultasi awal hingga serah terima kunci.

steps.title: Discovery & Briefing
steps.desc: Initial site inspection, spatial requirements analysis, aesthetic goal alignment, and preliminary budget framework definition.

steps.title: 2D CAD Drafting & BIM
steps.desc: Creating detailed architectural blueprints, structural engineering calculations, MEP schematics, and city permit documentation.

steps.title: 3D Render & VR Simulation
steps.desc: Photorealistic 8K visualizations and 360° VR walkthroughs allowing client approval of exact materials, lighting, and finishes.

steps.title: Procurement & Contracting
steps.desc: Fixed-price Bill of Quantities (BoQ), high-grade material sourcing, millwork fabrication, and milestone scheduling.

steps.title: Construction & Handover
steps.desc: On-site civil engineering build, continuous quality audits, site cleanup, and final turnkey key handover with warranty.
